One ticket. One vote. One crown.

Twenty vendors cook for a full day. Every ticket carries a QR code, so every guest gets a vote, and voting stays open from the first plate to the last.

The crowd decides 70 percent of the final score. A panel of judges scores the plates for the other 30. The highest combined score takes the title of Nairobi’s best wings, announced live on stage.

    Questions

    When and where is it?

    April 2027, in Nairobi. We are locking the venue and date now, and the early list hears first.

    How does voting work?

    Each ticket has a QR code tied to it, which gives you one vote. Voting is open all day and the crowd counts for 70 percent of the final score.

    Who are the judges?

    The panel is announced closer to the date. They score 30 percent of the final result.

    How do I enter as a vendor?

    Use the early list form and pick Cook. We keep the field to 20 spots and choose with care.

    Is it only wings?

    Wings are the centre of it. Around them you get a wing eating contest, chef masterclasses, hot sauce challenges, live music and DJs.

    Can my brand get involved?

    Yes. Founding partner positions are open now, and select categories can be made exclusive.

    Be first through the gate.

    Tickets are not on sale yet. Join the early list and your ticket comes to you first, with the date, the venue and a vote built in. Vendors and partners, pick your lane.
